chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan young man about 24, short curly black hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard yellow hoodie and dark jeans
chars.NEIGHBOUR: an elegant Moroccan woman about 30, shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair, cream blazer over an emerald green blouse, small gold hoop earrings
chars.BROTHER: a Moroccan teenage boy about 15, buzz cut, red football jersey and grey shorts
chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother about 50, burgundy headscarf, beige djellaba

scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical, comic. Small Moroccan bedroom in the morning. In bed under a blue blanket lies NARRATOR, the man with short curly hair, waking up startled, eyes wide, wearing the mustard yellow hoodie. At the open door stands BROTHER, the teenage boy with a buzz cut in a RED football jersey, knocking hard on the door and laughing. Only these two people. Faces visible in the centre.

scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. Moroccan family living room with low sofas. Exactly two people only: MOM hands a small folded paper with an address to NARRATOR, who wears a crisp white shirt and navy blazer and holds his phone; she smiles proudly. No other people. Head-to-waist framing, faces visible in the centre.
